.hero {
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: transform .1s, visibility .1s ease-in;
    margin: 0 auto 0 auto;
}

.hero img {
  display: inline-block;
  transition: all .5s;
  vertical-align: bottom;
  width: 100%;
  max-height: 350px;
  object-fit:cover;
  object-position: center top;
}

.hero img:hover {
  transform: scale(1.15);
}

.hero-facilities {

.mySlides {display: none}
img {vertical-align: middle;}

/* Slideshow container */
.slideshow-facilities {
  max-width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  margin: auto;
}

/* Slideshow next & previous buttons */
.moveleft, .moveright {
  cursor: pointer;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  width: auto;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-top: -22px;
  color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 18px;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
  border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
  user-select: none;
}

/* Slideshow Position the "next button" to the right */
.moveright {
  right: 0;
  border-radius: 3px 0 0 3px;
}

/* On hover, add a black background color with a little bit see-through */
.moveleft:hover, .moveright:hover {
  background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
}

/* Caption text
.text {
  color: #f2f2f2;
  font-size: 15px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 8px;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  background: rgba(18, 78, 132, 0.75);
} */

/* Number text (1/3 etc) */
.numbertext {
  color: #f2f2f2;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
}

/* The dots/bullets/indicators */
.dot {
  cursor: pointer;
  height: 15px;
  width: 15px;
  margin: 10px 3px;
  background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.active, .dot:hover { background-color: #ba0c2f; }

/* Fading animation */
.fade {
  -webkit-animation-name: fade;
  -webkit-animation-duration: 1s;
  animation-name: fade;
  animation-duration: 1s;
}

@-webkit-keyframes fade {
  from {opacity: .5} 
  to {opacity: 1}
}

@keyframes fade {
  from {opacity: .5} 
  to {opacity: 1}
}

/* On smaller screens, decrease text size */
@media only screen and (max-width: 300px) {
  .moveleft, .moveright,.text {font-size: 11px}
}
